name: crosshero
description: Follow a CrossHero gym's classes, billing, reports and your own scores, program its workouts, and set up its programs, timetable and plans.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your assistant to your CrossHero gym to follow day-to-day operations and plan workouts.

Check class schedules, capacity, booking counts and waiting lists, and cancel a class when a coach cannot make it (the members booked are notified by CrossHero). Review billing totals, invoice lists, sales by plan, dashboard figures, coach activity, class occupancy, attendance totals by plan and gender, active members by month, members at risk, no-show counts and member counts by gender and age group. If your gym programs workouts, read the programming, search the movement and benchmark library, and create, edit or delete workouts in any program. Set a new gym up, or change a running one, from the chat: create and edit programs, the weekly timetable and plans, and switch the workouts module on or off, with the same rules as the CrossHero settings pages.

Each connection is linked to one gym and uses your existing CrossHero permissions. You can view class schedules, billing and reports; booking and payment actions are not supported. You can also review your own scores (personal records and score history) to get load or RX/Scaled suggestions for a workout. The plugin does not provide member profiles, member contact details or other athletes' scores. Coach names may appear in schedules and reports.

Requires an existing CrossHero account with staff permissions and the AI connector enabled for your gym. Available tools depend on the permissions you approve and your access in CrossHero.
defaultPrompt: Which classes tomorrow have fewer than five people booked?
How much did we invoice last month, and how much is still unpaid?
What is the workout for today?

positive.description: Read programming across all gym programs.
positive.prompt: Show today's workout for every program in my gym.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each program with its ordered workout parts, or an explicit no-workout result for that program, using the gym's local date.

positive.description: Create programming without overwriting an existing workout.
positive.prompt: List my programs, then help me save a workout on an empty date in the program I choose: back squat 5x5 followed by a 12-minute AMRAP of 10 burpees and 15 box jumps.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the program and date as needed, checks history and movement/type keys, obtains write confirmation and saves ordered strength and AMRAP parts; an occupied date is refused without explicit replacement.

positive.description: Read the schedule with counts rather than member identities.
positive.prompt: Which classes today have fewer than five people booked?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching classes with booking and capacity counts and no member roster; missing sessions may be materialized from the recurring timetable and queued for configured Gympass synchronization.

positive.description: Inspect billing as an authorized administrator.
positive.prompt: How much did we invoice last month, and how much is still unpaid?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the previous calendar month's invoice totals and unpaid totals in the gym's currency, distinguishing invoice figures from collections.

positive.description: Suggest a load for today's workout from the user's own records.
positive.prompt: Look at today's workout and my results: what weight should I use for the back squat?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads today's workout and the user's own back squat history, and suggests a load from the prescribed percentage of the estimated one-rep max, naming the result it is based on.

negative.description: Member contact lookup is outside the connector.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number of the member booked into the 7am class.

negative.description: Subscription purchases and payments are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my CrossHero subscription and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Unrelated request does not trigger the plugin.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Madrid tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds gym settings: create and edit programs, the weekly timetable and plans, and switch the workouts module on or off, through the same permissions and rules as the CrossHero settings pages, plus a guided setup for gyms that have not finished onboarding. Adds cancelling a scheduled class, with the members booked notified as from the classes page. Members and memberships stay out of the connector. Also includes workout management and lookup access to class schedules, billing and reports, subject to existing gym permissions.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu centro y tus entrenamientos
es-ES.description:
Conecta tu asistente con tu centro en CrossHero para seguir su día a día y programar entrenamientos.

Revisa el horario de clases con aforo, reservas y lista de espera, y cancela una clase si el coach no puede darla (CrossHero avisa a los socios con reserva). Consulta la facturación, las ventas por tarifa, las cifras del panel, la actividad de los coaches, la ocupación, la asistencia, los socios activos por mes, los socios en riesgo, las ausencias y el número de socios por género y franja de edad. Si tu centro programa entrenamientos, consulta la programación, busca en la biblioteca de movimientos y benchmarks, y crea, edita o elimina entrenamientos en cualquier programa.

Cada conexión se vincula a un solo centro y usa los permisos que ya tienes en CrossHero. No permite reservar ni hacer pagos. También puedes revisar tus propios resultados (marcas personales e historial) para que te sugiera cargas o RX/Scaled. No da acceso a fichas de socios, a sus datos de contacto ni a los resultados de otros atletas. Los nombres de los coaches pueden aparecer en horarios e informes.

Requiere una cuenta de CrossHero con permisos de staff y el conector de IA activado en tu centro.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gestão da academia e treinos
pt-BR.description:
Conecte seu assistente à sua academia no CrossHero para acompanhar o dia a dia dela e planejar treinos.

Veja a grade de aulas com capacidade, reservas e lista de espera, e cancele uma aula quando o coach não puder dá-la (o CrossHero avisa os alunos com reserva). Acompanhe o faturamento, as vendas por plano, os números do painel, a atividade dos coaches, a ocupação, a frequência, os alunos ativos por mês, os alunos em risco, as faltas e o número de alunos por gênero e faixa etária. Se a sua academia programa treinos, consulte a programação, pesquise a biblioteca de movimentos e benchmarks, e crie, edite ou exclua treinos em qualquer programa.

Cada conexão fica vinculada a uma única academia e usa as permissões que você já tem no CrossHero. Não permite reservar nem fazer pagamentos. Você também pode revisar seus próprios resultados (recordes pessoais e histórico) para receber sugestões de carga ou RX/Scaled. Não dá acesso a perfis de alunos, a seus dados de contato nem aos resultados de outros atletas. Os nomes dos coaches podem aparecer em grades e relatórios.

Requer uma conta CrossHero com permissões de staff e o conector de IA ativado na sua academia.
